tex_content.html:
Proposition
[Existence of harmonic maps near the identity] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0240 1. ch33:33.12\group CMC and harmonic parametrizations

Let $(N^n,g)$ be compact with negative Ricci curvature and concave boundary. For every smooth metric $\widetilde g$ sufficiently close to $g$ in $C^{2,\alpha }$, there is a unique smooth harmonic diffeomorphism $F:(N,g)\to (N,\widetilde g)$, close to the identity, which maps the outward normal to a $\widetilde g$-normal along the boundary. For smoothly varying metrics, the resulting maps vary smoothly.
